personal.name: Nikolai Schunk
personal.tagline: Enthusiastic about code. Good with people. Ships things.
personal.motto: Shipping structured code that solves real-world problems.
bio: I'm a frontend-focused software engineer based in Zurich, working at an international tech consulting firm. My stack revolves around TypeScript and Next.js, though I'm comfortable across the full stack when needed.

I write code that's meant to be understood: simple, clear, and to the point. Knowing the right modern tools is what makes the difference between a slow process and a sharp, solution-oriented workflow. For me, keeping things simple isn't a limitation, it's a principle.
personal.philosophy: A product only has value if it's used. I build with a 'Keep It Simple, Stupid' mindset—ensuring code is readable for developers and interfaces are accessible for everyone. If it doesn't improve a user's day, it's over-engineered.

experience.description: Working with international clients on modern web solutions. Translating complex requirements into clean, scalable frontend implementations.
Building products, websites, and tools for clients and personal projects. From Discord bots to club websites.

Completed my apprenticeship while building full-stack features and learning solid software engineering fundamentals. Worked in agile teams on client projects, which gave me exposure to different industries and ways of working.

projects.name: Birthdayy
projects.description: A Discord bot and web app for tracking birthdays across servers, used by thousands of communities. Built the full product from bot to landing page.

projects.name: VBC Rämi Website
projects.description: Designed and built the website for my volleyball club VBC Rämi. I also integrated Sanity CMS so the club can update the content without needing a developer.

projects.name: Volleyball Scoreboard
projects.description: A match-day scoreboard you can run from your phone: tap/swipe to update points, track sets and timeouts, and share a short live link so spectators can follow along in real time.

projects.name: ICON apps
projects.description: Data cleanup and visualisation tools for different data analysis use cases for the icon outdoor company, saving hours of work every week and increasing workflow efficiency by 160%.
